{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
completed_count = df[df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_count}')
print(f'Completed orders: {completed_count}')

# Verify total
assert completed_count + refunded_count == len(df), 'Total orders do not match sum of completed and refunded'

completed_count"}
